title: "Shinzo Abe Had Many Plans For World": Wife Breaks Down At NDTV Summit
summary_full: Reminiscing about July 8, the day the former Japanese PM was shot dead during a political event in the nation's Nara, Abe said he was in a very good mood and had breakfast with her and his mother.
